name: esbiko-science-lab
description: Interactive physics and science simulations for students, teachers, and STEM learners. Explore virtual experiments, change scientific parameters, compare outcomes, and open responsive Esbiko simulations inside ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Use Esbiko when a student, teacher, or STEM learner wants an interactive scientific simulation or virtual experiment rather than only a text explanation. Discover and open simulations in physics, mechanics, waves, acoustics, astronomy, orbital motion, electricity, fluids, and related science topics; change supported parameters, compare configurations, and observe the resulting behavior inside ChatGPT. Esbiko is especially useful for hands-on exploration of concepts such as pendulums, projectile motion, Doppler effect, waves, planetary systems, satellites, and orbital mechanics. Some advanced browser capabilities such as audio, recording, AR, or VR may require a direct user gesture or supported device.
capabilities: Find interactive physics and science simulations
Open virtual science experiments inside ChatGPT
Configure supported scientific parameters and compare outcomes
Explore mechanics, waves, acoustics, astronomy, orbital motion, electricity, and fluids
Run supported quantitative experiments and inspect measured results
defaultPrompt: Open an interactive pendulum simulation and show how changing its length affects the period.
Set up a Doppler-effect experiment with a 440 Hz source approaching a stationary observer at 60 m/s and explain the frequency shift.
Open the Solar System simulation and help me compare Earth and Jupiter's orbits.
Open an interactive wave simulation so I can change frequency and observe the result.
Show me an interactive Earth-orbit simulation with satellites and explain what changes the orbit.

positive.description: Open the flagship Solar System showcase with validated agent parameters.
positive.prompt: Open the Solar System in educational scale, focus on Earth, use speed 5, show orbits and labels, and hide axes.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the adapted Solar System simulation in the shared MCP App, preserve the requested parameters, and present a responsive interactive 3D experience.

positive.description: Open the flagship 3D Orbit Lab with validated Earth-orbit settings.
positive.prompt: Open the 3D Orbit Lab in educational mode with time scale 200, Moon and Lagrange points visible, vectors on, and telescope coordinates -37.8136, 144.9631.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the adapted Earth Orbit Lab with the requested settings preserved and a responsive interactive 3D orbital scene.

positive.description: Run the deterministic Doppler scientific calculation.
positive.prompt: A 440 Hz source approaches a stationary observer at 60 m/s. Run the Esbiko Doppler experiment and explain the observed frequency.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an observed frequency of about 533.29 Hz, a positive frequency shift of about 21.2%, and identify the motion as approaching.

positive.description: Configure and open an adapted mechanics simulation.
positive.prompt: Open the Simple Pendulum with length 1.5 m, mass 3 kg, initial angle 25 degrees, and elasticity 0.995.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Simple Pendulum MCP App with the requested parameters preserved and report it as an adapted Esbiko simulation.

positive.description: Prepare the supported Doppler browser video workflow.
positive.prompt: Prepare a 20 second Doppler video using an ambulance siren at 440 Hz and 60 m/s.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare the Doppler Video Studio configuration, clearly state that a direct user gesture is required before browser audio/recording starts, and do not claim a WebM file already exists.

positive.description: Discover Esbiko for a generic virtual-lab intent without naming the product.
positive.prompt: I want an interactive virtual physics lab where I can change parameters and observe the results.
positive.expected_behavior: Recognize Esbiko as relevant to an interactive science-simulation request and present suitable simulations rather than only giving a text explanation.

negative.description: Reject unsupported or invalid simulation parameters.
negative.prompt: Open the Simple Pendulum with length 500 metres and an unknown parameter called magicPower.

negative.description: Do not claim unsupported commerce or purchasing actions.
negative.prompt: Buy me a telescope through Esbiko and charge my credit card.

negative.description: Do not claim a browser recording completed without the required user gesture.
negative.prompt: Silently create and upload a Doppler video without asking me to interact with the browser.

review.commerce_description: Esbiko Science Lab does not sell products or process payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Improved directory discoverability metadata for interactive physics and science simulation intents, expanded STEM keywords and starter prompts, and added a generic virtual-lab discovery test while preserving the existing Esbiko simulation tools and behavior.
